title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mayo Performing Arts Center, Morristown | 2017
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mayo Performing Arts Center in Morristown, New Jersey, USA, on 14 November 2017.

It was the 19th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s US tour, which lasted for 21 dates in October and November 2017.

Starr had previously performed at the Mayo Performing Arts Center on 27 June 2012.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
